templates.title: netboot.xyz
templates.name: netboot-xyz
templates.description: netboot.xyz is a PXE app: an iPXE menu that boots OS installers and utilities over the network. This Universal App wraps the official container (web UI, TFTP, local asset HTTP). It does not run DHCP; point the LAN DHCP next-server and bootfile at this host.
templates.note: Network boot menu (iPXE) with TFTP and a web UI
